Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Financial Planning & Business Intelligence Analyst role at Jam+. The posting describes budgeting, forecasting and sales analytics under one analyst, and that is close to what I do every day.

Since August 2023 I have been the Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA. I build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, compare actual results to budget, and write the variance analysis and KPI reports that ownership uses to make decisions. While tightening our financial reporting and reconciliation, I found and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue and brought A/R aging down 10%. That work taught me to trace a number back to its source, which is exactly what your reconciliation of business reporting to financial results calls for.

I also have the data side you list. I work in Excel at an advanced level, and I know SQL, Python with Pandas and NumPy, and Tableau. At Northrop Grumman I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy and internal controls, so I am comfortable documenting metric definitions and checking migrated data, which matters for your Microsoft Fabric and Power BI implementation.

I have not worked in NetSuite. I have used SAP for cost tracking, and I expect saved searches and transaction extracts to come quickly. I hold an M.A. in International Economics & Finance from Brandeis and a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk.

I would welcome the chance to support Jam+ across finance, sales and operations from a remote setup, and I am available immediately.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
